description: This Java class 'FilesController' is a Spring MVC web controller responsible for handling HTTP requests related to serving static and downloadable files within a web application, specifically tied to a shopping or content management system.

classes.name: FilesController
classes.description: Controller managing file download endpoints, extending AbstractController, and handling requests for static files and product digital files.

methods.name: downloadFile
methods.description: Handles requests to download static files like CSS and JS for a specific store, retrieves the content via ContentService, and returns the file bytes or 404 if not found.

methods.name: downloadProduct
methods.description: Handles admin-level requests to download product digital files, sets response headers for attachment disposition, and returns file bytes or 404 if not found.
